1983.notes: 2% on residents and 1% on nonresidents: the ACIR Significant Features of Fiscal Federalism 1981-82 edition (M-135, April 1983), Table 31 (State and local general sales tax rates and personal income tax rates, December 31, 1982), note 12 (p. 50): 'city of Highland Park rate is 2% for residents, 1% for non-residents, effective 7/1/82'. Highland Park Codified Ordinances sec. 890.03 (Ord. 1104, passed 8-16-82, under MCL 141.503a) has no later amendment of the rate section, and this file's 1985 entry is 2%, so the rate is carried across 1983. The House and Senate analyses of SB 451 of 1987 say the voter approval required before July 1, 1984 was given. (The ACIR's July 1, 1982 effective date conflicts with this file's 1982 entry, which reads MCL 141.503(4) as deferring the ordinance to January 1, 1983; either way the 2% rate was in force throughout 1983.)
